_note: Where each prop stands and what it takes to earn it. Coordinates are normalized over the 1280x1280 hall image and anchor the prop's FEET (origin 0.5, 1). `lvl` gates on that room's facility level; `bosses` gates on bosses cleared. The hall is COMPOSED now (tools/gen_hall_build.py): base furniture is stamped into hall.png by that tool, and dormitory/smithy/training tiers are baked into assets/hall/rooms/ — so this file holds only what a LEVEL or a BOSS earns. Anything solid added here also needs a rect in SOLIDS in js/hall.js, then node tools/check_hall_paths.mjs.
